## Summary

<!-- What does this PR do, and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] fix (bug fix, non-breaking)
- [ ] feat (new feature, non-breaking)
- [ ] docs (documentation only)
- [ ] chore (tooling, dependencies, CI, build)
- [ ] refactor / perf
- [ ] BREAKING CHANGE

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and passing (`npm test`, plus `npm run test:browser` for runtime changes)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run format:check` pass
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm run check:package` pass (for runtime or packaging changes)
- [ ] Public API changes are reflected in the JSDoc, `docs/api.md`, the README and `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Documentation code blocks still run (`npm run docs:test`), and generated files were regenerated, not edited
- [ ] The frozen v1 file is untouched, or the commit message contains `[v1-change]`
